sentences.target: -(으)ㄹ 뻔하다는 어떤 일이 거의 일어날 뻔했지만 실제로는 일어나지 않은 상황을 나타낸다.
sentences.en: The form -(으)ㄹ 뻔하다 describes a situation that almost happened but did not actually occur.

sentences.target: 예상치 못한 위험이나 아찔한 순간을 표현할 때 자주 사용된다.
sentences.en: It is often used to express unexpected danger or a close call.

sentences.target: 주로 과거 시점에서 경험을 회상할 때 쓰인다.
sentences.en: It is mainly used when recalling a past experience.

sentences.target: '거의 ~할 뻔했다'라는 의미로 이해하면 쉽다.
sentences.en: It carries the meaning of “I almost did ~” or “Something almost happened.”

sentences.target: 부정적 결과를 강조할 때 자연스럽다.
sentences.en: It is natural when emphasizing a negative or undesired outcome.

sentences.target: 뜻밖의 실수나 사고를 언급할 때도 많이 사용된다.
sentences.en: It is commonly used when mentioning accidents or mistakes that were avoided.

sentences.target: 감탄, 안도, 놀람의 감정이 함께 포함되는 경우가 많다.
sentences.en: It often conveys emotions such as surprise, relief, or shock.

sentences.target: 문장 끝에는 보통 '했어', '했다', '할 뻔했어' 등 과거형을 사용한다.
sentences.en: The sentence usually ends in a past-tense form such as “almost did,” “was about to,” or “nearly happened.”

sentences.target: 계획적이거나 의도적 상황에는 잘 쓰이지 않는다.
sentences.en: It is not typically used for planned or intentional situations.

sentences.target: 문장 전체는 실제 결과가 일어나지 않았다는 점을 명확히 보여준다.
sentences.en: The sentence must clearly show that the event did not actually occur.

sentences.target: 늦잠 자서 수업에 늦을 뻔했어.
sentences.en: I almost arrived late to class because I overslept.

sentences.target: 길을 잘못 들어서 버스를 놓칠 뻔했어.
sentences.en: I took the wrong road and almost missed the bus.

sentences.target: 핸드폰을 떨어뜨려서 깨질 뻔했어.
sentences.en: I dropped my phone and it almost broke.

sentences.target: 비가 갑자기 와서 옷이 다 젖을 뻔했어.
sentences.en: It suddenly rained and my clothes almost got soaked.

sentences.target: 차가 갑자기 멈춰서 넘어질 뻔했어.
sentences.en: The car stopped abruptly and I almost fell.

sentences.target: 신호를 못 보고 사고 날 뻔했어.
sentences.en: I didn’t see the signal and almost got into an accident.

sentences.target: 급하게 나가느라 지갑을 두고 올 뻔했어.
sentences.en: I rushed out and almost left my wallet at home.

sentences.target: 정신이 없어서 약속을 잊어버릴 뻔했어.
sentences.en: I was so distracted that I almost forgot the appointment.

sentences.target: 발을 헛디뎌서 넘어질 뻔했어.
sentences.en: I slipped and almost fell.

sentences.target: 메시지를 잘못 보내서 오해받을 뻔했어.
sentences.en: I almost sent the wrong message and caused a misunderstanding.

sentences.target: 손잡이를 놓쳐서 떨어질 뻔했어.
sentences.en: I lost my grip and almost fell down.

sentences.target: 잠깐 딴생각해서 길을 놓칠 뻔했어.
sentences.en: I got distracted for a moment and almost missed the turn.

sentences.target: 너무 긴장해서 발표를 시작 못 할 뻔했어.
sentences.en: I was so nervous that I almost couldn’t start my presentation.

sentences.target: 계산을 잘못해서 큰 실수를 저지를 뻔했어.
sentences.en: I miscalculated and almost made a big mistake.

sentences.target: 차가 미끄러져서 큰일 날 뻔했어.
sentences.en: The car slid and it almost turned into a serious accident.

sentences.target: 방향을 착각해서 완전히 다른 곳으로 갈 뻔했어.
sentences.en: I confused the direction and almost went somewhere completely different.

sentences.target: 비밀번호를 잘못 입력해서 잠겨 버릴 뻔했어.
sentences.en: I entered the wrong password and almost got locked out.

sentences.target: 전화에 집중하다가 내릴 곳을 지나칠 뻔했어.
sentences.en: I was focused on my phone and almost missed my stop.

sentences.target: 줄을 잘못 서서 시간을 두 배로 쓸 뻔했어.
sentences.en: I stood in the wrong line and almost wasted twice as much time.

sentences.target: 너무 선명해서 진짜라고 생각할 뻔했어.
sentences.en: It was so realistic that I almost thought it was real.
